external_collaboration.evidence_quote: We work in close partnership with the University of Leeds Security Service, West Yorkshire Police, and local partners — and we also operate our own, highly trained, SIA licensed LUU security team, run independently from campus security, dedicated to safeguarding you inside our venues.

We work in close partnership with the University of Leeds Security Service, West Yorkshire Police, and local partners — and we also operate our own, highly trained, SIA licensed LUU security team, run independently from campus security, dedicated to safeguarding you inside our venues.

Veezu – Safe Rides for University of Leeds Students: To support University of Leeds students needing a taxi, Veezu has partnered with LUU to offer a Safe Rides Scheme. This service provides emergency transport for students who find themselves stuck, unable to pay and in need of a ride home.

This year, Essentials, LUU’s basic needs hub, has entered into a brand new partnership with Fare Share. Created for students who may have financial difficulties, Essentials will help you find emergency food assistance, breakfast products and personal items when you need them the most. Students can access a range of ambient, household and stationery items each week and from September we will be hosting a range of workshops and events to enhance student sense of belonging.
